summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 21 tests) + frontend (Playwright) testing of HatchKod LMS. All 3 role logins work and redirect correctly. Full submission lifecycle (submit → rework → resubmit → approve → unlock next lesson) verified on backend. Lock/unlock progression, role enforcement, admin CRUD cascade, mentor assignment, and all dashboards working. UI renders cleanly across landing/login/admin/mentor/student dashboards.

minor.issue: Endpoint does not enforce a rate limit / lockout (no brute-force protection on login either). Not in MVP scope but flagging.
Returns submissions where mentor_id is None to ALL mentors. With multiple mentors this would expose unassigned submissions cross-mentor. Acceptable for MVP since only one mentor seeded.

action_items: Optional hardening (out of MVP scope): add login rate-limit / lockout (problem statement mentioned brute-force lockout in playbook).
Optional: scope unassigned pending submissions per-mentor or restrict to admin only when multiple mentors exist.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 800-line file; consider splitting into routers/auth/courses/submissions for maintainability (>700 line guideline).

CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — fine because frontend uses Bearer token, but the backend still sets httpOnly cookie that can never be sent cross-origin. Either drop the cookie code or tighten CORS with explicit origin + allow_credentials=True.
JWT_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded dev string when env missing; should fail-fast in production.

is_lesson_unlocked treats 'previous lesson with no task' as auto-unlocked, which is correct, but the cross-module ordering relies on get_ordered_lessons concatenating modules by sequence_order — confirmed working.
All endpoints exclude _id correctly via projection, no ObjectId leakage observed.
All interactive elements have data-testid as required.

success_rate.backend: 100% on first run (21/21). On re-run, 1 progression test fails / 1 skips due to test state carry-over — student_progress for Lesson 1 persists. Not a backend bug; correct product behavior is that once approved, lesson stays unlocked even if a later resubmission is in rework.

seed_data_creation: No new seed data; backend auto-seeds course/modules/lessons/tasks. Tests created TEST_-prefixed users and a TEST course (course was deleted in same test). Student account now has Lesson 1 approved as a side-effect of running the full progression test (25% progress visible).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py cover all critical flows. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Note: full_submit_review_flow leaves student with Lesson 1 approved (and Lesson 2 unlocked). To re-test the locked-state, wipe submissions/student_progress collections or reset DB. The test_second_lesson_locked_initially gracefully skips if already unlocked.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA. The single failed test on first run (test_register_new_student) was a test-side error — backend correctly lowercases emails per RegisterIn endpoint, test was asserting against raw mixed-case input. Fixed by comparing against email.lower().
